items.title: How many games until team stats actually mean something?
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
How many games until team stats actually mean something?

Thanks to research by @knarsu3.bsky.social this chart shows when each stat starts to stabilize and become reliable. After one game, everything’s noise!

I’ll update you throughout the season to show which stats we can actually start trusting.

images.alt: Chart titled "# of games until we can trust team stats." Horizontal bars show roughly when each NBA team stat becomes reliable, by game number. Earliest to stabilize, around games 4 to 9: pace, three-point attempt rate, free throw rate and assist percentage. Middle range, games 7 to 20: opponent three-point attempt rate, win percentage, net rating, turnover percentage, two-point percentage, offensive rebound percentage, true shooting percentage, offensive rating, opponent free throw rate, defensive rebound percentage and opponent turnover percentage. Free throw percentage and defensive rating settle around games 16 to 21. Three-point percentage takes longest, around games 27 to 30. Research by Krishna Narsu, posted to Nylon Calculus. Visual by Hoop Informatics.
